pages.lesson:
LESSON: GENERAL ETIQUETTE

Grade: PP1
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Sadachar
Topic 6.1: General Etiquette

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about General Etiquette. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you greet your learner should be able to: digital parents/guardians/elders/friends?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups
2. appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups
   In simple words: practise until you can demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all
   In simple words: practise until you can appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about General Etiquette using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about General Etiquette in the examples.
2. Explain General Etiquette to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand General Etiquette.
4. Show that you can: demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about General Etiquette using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is General Etiquette important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you greet your learner should be able to: digital parents/guardians/elders/friends?
2. How do you greet the priest at greetings used at places of the different forms of the place of worship?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. demonstrate appropriate • Learner practices and role greetings to show respect for play greetings in pairs or different ages groups
2. appreciate the importance of greetings for love and respect to all

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
